relations.subject: LEBEDEV, Gerasim Stepanovič
relations.evidence: In 1787 he moved from Madras to Calcutta. Now learned Bengali, Urdu and Sanskrit from Pandit Golok Nath Das.

relations.subject: LEBEDEV, Gerasim Stepanovič
relations.evidence: he translated and adapted two farces, The Disguise by R. P. Jodrell (transferred to Indian surroundings) and Molière’s Love is the Best Doctor , from English into Bengali (assisted by his teacher Goloknath Das)

relations.subject: LEBEDEV, Gerasim Stepanovič
relations.evidence: After a period in Londonhe returned in 1801 to Russia, where he was appointed an interpreter in the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and spent the rest of his life as minor civil servant in St.Petersburg.
